title: Tutor Session Trace
user: One-to-one remote coding tutors who need a lightweight record of student attempts, handoffs, and next practice tasks while teaching through existing video and editor tools.
smallest_useful_product: A small web app with timestamped lesson moments, attempt/outcome tags, code snippet or link attachment, student-visible next task, and PDF/Markdown recap.
constraints: Avoid storing credentials or full private repositories; explicit student consent for notes; configurable deletion and share expiry.
